'''Samara Breesh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Breesh also provided the knowledge of synthweaving to others.
